name: besteffort1.k
model:
@timeout(5000)
@bestEffort(null)

class BestEffort1 {
  x:Int
  y:Int
  z:Int

  req x >= 1

  req x <= 100

  req y >= 1

  req y <= 100

  req z >= 1

  req z <= 100

  req x + y + z <= 150

  req x * 2 <= y + z
  maximize x
}

main:BestEffort1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((BestEffort1 (mk-BestEffort1 (x Int)(y Int)(z Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-BestEffort1 (sel-BestEffort1 BestEffort1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-BestEffort1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-BestEffort1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-BestEffort1 ((this Ref)) BestEffort1
  (sel-BestEffort1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-BestEffort1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-BestEffort1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------
;   Getters for class BestEffort1:
; ----------------------------------

; --- getters for BestEffort1.x: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-BestEffort1 this))
)

; --- getters for BestEffort1.y: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-BestEffort1 this))
)

; --- getters for BestEffort1.z: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1!z ((this Ref)) Int
  (z (deref-BestEffort1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-BestEffort1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class BestEffort1:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-BestEffort1 BestEffort1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (BestEffort1!x this) 1)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (BestEffort1!x this) 100)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (BestEffort1!y this) 1)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (BestEffort1!y this) 100)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (BestEffort1!z this) 1)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (BestEffort1!z this) 100)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (+ (+ (BestEffort1!x this) (BestEffort1!y this)) (BestEffort1!z this)) 150)
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv7 1) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun BestEffort1.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (* (BestEffort1!x this) 2) (+ (BestEffort1!y this) (BestEffort1!z this)))
)

(assert (! (BestEffort1.inv8 1) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Optimization Objectives (informational): ---

; (maximize (BestEffort1!x this))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-BestEffort1 const-1-BestEffort1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-BestEffort1 () BestEffort1
  (mk-BestEffort1 1 20 39))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (x (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1)))
              (y (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1)))
              (z (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))))))
  (<= a!1 150)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (x (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (>= (z (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-BestEffort1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (* (x (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 2))
      (a!2 (+ (y (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1)))
              (z (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))))))
  (<= a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (y (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (x (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (<= (z (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (y (sel-BestEffort1 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-BestEffort1 (mk-BestEffort1 1 20 39))))
